question: Câu 601: Kate, with ________ I studied in the secondary school, is now a famous surgeon.
explanation: whom đi với giới từ with (with whom).

question: Câu 602: Some people argue that it is ________ justifiable to hold national events and festivals because of advantages they bring to our country.
explanation: entirely: hoàn toàn.

question: Câu 603: It's your own fault. You ________ them to go out on their own; they are still new here.
explanation: shouldn't have + VpII: lẽ ra không nên làm gì trong quá khứ.

question: Câu 604: As was ________ predicted, the superstar couple from a famous TV show has broken up.
explanation: widely predicted: được dự đoán rộng rãi.

question: Câu 605: The best day to visit is Saturday, when there's ______ in the main square.
explanation: an open-air market: chợ ngoài trời.

question: Câu 606: Many Vietnamese people ______ their lives for the revolutionary cause of the nation.
explanation: Động từ chia quá khứ đơn: sacrificed.

question: Câu 607: There ______ something vaguely familiar about her face but I couldn't remember where I ______ her before.
explanation: Quá khứ đơn + quá khứ hoàn thành (hành động trước).

question: Câu 608: Who will pay for the coach if almost two fifths of the passengers ______ a free ride?
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + S + V(s/es)...

question: Câu 609: Discount broker TD Waterhouse has stirred up a hornets' ______ with the announcement that it will introduce margin trading into the UK.
explanation: a hornets' nest: tình huống khó chịu, rắc rối.

question: Câu 610: The chief foods eaten in any country depend largely on ______ best in its climate and soil.
explanation: Mệnh đề danh từ: what + V.

question: Câu 611: The injured athlete was told that the effect of the anaesthetic wore off, he might feel a little pain.
explanation: wear off = disappear: hết tác dụng.

question: Câu 612: Private sponsors have experts in different areas of technology ranging from nutrition to the treatment of injuries.
explanation: sponsor = patron: nhà tài trợ.

question: Câu 613: His extraordinary talent was already clearly evident in the professional sporting world.
explanation: extraordinary >< conventional: thông thường.

question: Câu 614: In sport commentaries, justice and impartiality to both sides are vital...
explanation: impartiality >< unfairness: sự không công bằng.

question: Câu 615: Peter: "Hi, David, do you think it's possible for you to have a talk sometime today?" David: “________”
options: I'd love to, but I've got a pretty tight schedule today.
No more time for me. I have to work with my boss.
I wish I had been free yesterday to have time with you.
Excuse me; however, I'm so busy all day from morning.
explanation: Từ chối lịch sự vì lịch kín.

question: Câu 616: Mark: “Why did you bring up this subject all of a sudden?” Hoa: “_________”
options: I had a hunch about it.
It was just a simple thought.
explanation: It just occurred to me: vừa nảy ra trong đầu.

question: Câu 617: Nick: “I’m really tired. I’m taking next week off.” Michael: “________”
options: Well, you must be telling a lie!
Take care, my love. Have a nice weekend!
That sounds like a good idea. The break will do you good.
Really? I don’t know what you are going to do.
explanation: Đồng tình và khuyến khích nghỉ ngơi.

question: Câu 618: Teacher: “Your speech this morning was beyond my expectation.” Laura: “________”
options: Thanks. Without your help, I couldn’t have.
Are you kidding me? It’s terrible.
It’s OK. It was the least I could do.
That's alright. I'm glad I could help.
explanation: Cảm ơn và khiêm tốn.

question: Câu 619: a. Why is that? b. It looks like it may rain soon. c. I really love how rain clears the air. d. Yes, and I hope that it does.
explanation: Thứ tự: nhận xét thời tiết → đồng ý → hỏi lý do → giải thích.

question: Câu 620: a. That's true. It is a very funny movie. b. I saw that movie the first day it came out in theaters. c. You've seen it before? d. Superbad is the funniest movie that I've ever seen.
explanation: Thứ tự: khen phim → đồng ý → hỏi đã xem chưa → trả lời.

question: Câu 621: a. I see that you're pretty talented. b. I wish I had a talent like that. c. Oh, so you took an art class? d. I'm sure you have a talent. It's just hidden. e. Yeah, I loved that class. f. Thank you very much.
explanation: Thứ tự logic về tài năng vẽ.

question: Câu 622: a. I hope you feel better. b. My stomach was upset. c. Do you want anything to make you feel better? d. I don't really feel too well yet. e. Do you feel better now? f. No, thanks. I already took some medicine.
explanation: Thứ tự hỏi thăm sức khỏe.

question: Câu 623: I couldn't help admiring the way he managed to finish the programme even after such a bad fall.
options: The way he finished the programme was certainly admirable, as the fall had shaken him up badly.
It was really a very bad fall, but somehow he was still able to finish the programme and I had to admire him for that.
In spite of the fall, he should have finished the programme and we could have admired him for that.
I really admire the way he got up after the fall and completed the programme.
explanation: Gần nghĩa nhất với couldn't help admiring + even after such a bad fall.

question: Câu 624: The noise next door didn't stop until midnight.
options: Not until midnight did the noise next door stopped.
Hardly had the noise next door stopped than it was midnight.
It was not until midnight that the noise next door stopped.
Only when midnight did the noise next door stopped.
explanation: It was not until + time + that + clause.

question: Câu 625: He can shout even louder, but I won't take any notice.
options: No matter how loud he can shout, I won't take any notice.
He can shout even louder won't take any of my notice.
Whatever ability he shout won't take notice of me.
However loud he can shout, but I won't take any notice.
explanation: No matter how + adj/adv...

question: Câu 626: The student next to me kept chewing gum. That bothered me a lot.
options: The student next to me kept chewing gum, which bothered me a lot.
The student next to me kept chewing gum, that bothered me a lot.
The student next to me kept chewing gum bothering me a lot.
The student next to me kept chewing gum bothered me a lot.
explanation: which thay thế cả mệnh đề trước.

question: Câu 627: Sunbathing is still a popular activity. People do it even though they know it can cause cancer.
options: Despite the fact that sunbathing can cause cancer, it is still a popular activity.
Because sunbathing is still a popular activity, it can cause cancer.
Sunbathing is still a popular activity as long as it can cause cancer.
Unless it can cause cancer, sunbathing is still a popular activity.
explanation: Despite the fact that = although.

question: Câu 628: There used to be a theatre here. It was torn down a few years ago.
options: Since there used to be a theatre here, it was torn down a few years ago.
The theatre which was torn down a few years ago had not been used.
There used to be a theatre here, but it was torn down a few years ago.
A theatre was used here, but it was torn down a few years ago.
explanation: used to + but: đã từng có nhưng giờ không còn.

question: Câu 629: Safety instructions are given in symbols. People can quickly comprehend them.
options: Safety instructions are given in symbols, so that people can quickly comprehend them.
Safety instructions are given in symbols where people can quickly comprehend them.
People can quickly comprehend safety instructions whether they are given in symbols.
People can quickly comprehend safety instructions in which symbols are given.
explanation: so that: để mà.

question: Câu 630: Both of them worked hard. They could pass the entrance examination.
options: Both of them worked hard so that they could pass the entrance examination.
They could pass the entrance examination in order that both of them worked hard.
Both of them worked hard since they could pass the entrance examination.
They could pass the entrance examination even though both of them worked hard.
explanation: so that: để đạt được mục đích.

question: Câu 631: ... children (631) ____ have suffered from compounded crises for almost 12 years now...
explanation: who thay thế cho children (chủ ngữ).

question: Câu 632: It is crucial that (632) ____ access channels to northwest Syria remain open...
explanation: all + N số nhiều: tất cả các kênh tiếp cận.

question: Câu 633: ... at great risk of hypothermia (633) ____ they struggle to survive in sub-zero temperatures.
explanation: as = because.

question: Câu 634: Doctors (634) ____ that children are also at risk of exposure to waterborne diseases...
explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành nhấn mạnh kết quả.

question: Câu 635: ... a health crisis -fueled by reduced healthcare capacity and disease (635) ____.
explanation: disease outbreaks: dịch bệnh bùng phát.

question: Câu 636: Who said the price of the uniform was clearly expensive?
options: Parents of a Tokyo elementary school
A public elementary school in Tokyo
explanation: Phụ huynh phản đối giá quá cao (exorbitant).

question: Câu 637: What does the passage mainly discuss?
options: Japanese parliament discussed raising school uniform prices
Schools to remove the financial burden on Japanese parents
Parents protesting against high uniform prices
explanation: Ý chính: phụ huynh phản đối giá đồng phục cao.

question: Câu 638: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “up in arms” as used in the passage?
options: very angry and ready to argue
explanation: up in arms = rất tức giận và sẵn sàng tranh cãi.

question: Câu 639: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “created such a fuss” as used in the passage?
explanation: created such a fuss ≈ sparked anger / gây tranh cãi.

question: Câu 640: Why did the school want such an expensive uniform?
options: It wanted the uniform to be a present.
It wanted to represent the uniform.
The uniform was meant to represent the wealthiness of Ginza.
It wanted the parents to get angry.
explanation: The school said it wanted a designer uniform that represented the rich area of Ginza.

question: Câu 641: What is the main idea of this reading?
options: How names reflect a person's culture.
How Asian people name their children.
explanation: Tên phản ánh văn hóa của người đó.

question: Câu 642: It can be inferred from the passage that names in China would relate to______.
explanation: Names believed to shape the child's character.

question: Câu 643: Which is true in Akan culture if a twin brother and sister are born on a Friday?
options: They will both be named Afua.
They will have to travel to a different city.
They will both be named Kofi.
explanation: Boy: Kofi, girl: Afua → khác nhau.

question: Câu 644: The word "dictated" in the passage is closest in meaning to ______.
explanation: dictated by tradition = determined by tradition.

question: Câu 645: According to the reading passage, which would probably NOT be found in the meaning of children's name across the world?
explanation: Không đề cập đến nơi sinh.

question: Câu 646: You have an important meeting today at the office. However, you have missed the bus, and you are going to be late for the meeting. What will you say when you enter the meeting room?
options: So, you all have started the meeting?
How is the meeting going on? Is it great?
Everybody seems to be having fun without me.
My apology. Let's go on with the meeting.
explanation: Xin lỗi và đề nghị tiếp tục họp.

question: Câu 647: Which of the following is a generalisation about an animal?
options: That lion ate a horse yesterday.
explanation: Generalisation: Lions are carnivores.

question: Câu 648: Today is your graduation day. A relative has approached and said: “Congratulations on your graduation! All your hard work and dedication have truly paid off.” How would you reply to him?
options: I'm so proud of myself! I have worked so hard to reach this milestone.
Thanks, but it wasn't that big of a deal
Thank you so much! I really appreciate your kind words and support.
Thanks, but I'm not sure what's next.
explanation: Cảm ơn lịch sự và khiêm tốn.

question: Câu 649: Which of the following situation best exemplifies “trade-in”?
options: You bring your old phone to a retailer. He values it at $200 and refuses to sell a new phone to you.
You bring your old phone to a retailer. He values it at 200 dollars and sells you a new phone at exactly 200 dollars.
You bring your old phone to a retailer. He values it at $200 and adds this amount to the price of your new phone.
You bring your old phone to a retailer. He values it at $200 and deducts this amount from the price of your new phone.
explanation: Trade-in: trừ giá trị máy cũ vào giá máy mới.

question: Câu 650: You are on a street and a stranger approaches you to ask: “Excuse me, where’s Tran Hung Dao Street, please?”
explanation: Chỉ đường: Over there, I believe.
